# Proposal: Richard Welsh, Edgeware R&D October / November invoice 4 (Post paid)

## **First posted **
**30/11/2022**

## **On-Chain**
**2/12/2022**

## **Invoice to cover **

- October and November R&D 
- Refund of bond lost in failed [Sign Language Tutorial proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4932-proposal-creation-of-sign-language-based-tutorials-around-the-edgeware-for-people-with-disabilities) 
- [referenda 129](https://edgeware.subscan.io/referenda/129) / [treasury prop 107](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/107) 


## **Report**

- Created fully itemised [status sheet ](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gu-5YklgTp2f3eDm25Mp6xu2kefP_fp0EW1xSdZD7LY/edit?usp=sharing)for people to track projects involved in the Network Services model


- New [Decent Partners site](https://decent.partners), which will begin to become a primary onboarding location for new projects and also a way to market on-chain organisations that exist on Edgeware and Kabocha. 


- Decent Partners will become a multi-chain delegate through the new [OpenGov system](https://polkaworld.medium.com/opengov-goes-live-on-kusama-network-1ab5d19cb936) - EDG, KAB, KSM and DOT - linking the networks and communities through a coordinated organisational structure. 


- Introduced [ParaNotes discussion](https://forum.polkadot.network/t/introducing-paranotes-regenerative-defi-for-advancing-the-paraverse/1002) into the Polkadot Forum. Ongoing discussions around this model and associated aspects with key parity team members.


- Creating [The Messari of Dotsama](https://forum.polkadot.network/t/creating-the-messari-of-dotsama/958) post within the Polkadot forum. 


- New post on Decent Partners site introducing [The Past, Present and Future of Network Services](https://decent.partners/direction/the-past-present-and-future-of-network-services) - will be adding key information about Edgewa
